articles.title: How Stellar became part of DTCC's tokenization push for Wall Street securities onchain
articles.snippet: Wall Street's clearing giant chose a public blockchain with compliance tools built for regulated assets, Stellar Development Foundation CEO Denelle Dixon said.

articles.title: Paxos wins SEC approval to clear U.S. stocks on blockchain

articles.title: Cosmos-based Gravity Bridge halts bridge after reported $5.4M exploit
articles.snippet: Gravity Bridge was drained of roughly $5.4 million in a suspected signing key compromise, prompting validators to halt the bridge while an investigation is underway.
